title: Refurbishing a Tektronix TDS7104 Oscilloscope
summary: A detailed walkthrough of restoring a vintage Tektronix TDS7104 digital oscilloscope to working condition, covering diagnostic procedures, component replacement, and calibration steps to revive expensive lab equipment that would otherwise be discarded.
problem_solved: Extends the operational life of costly professional test equipment by restoring functionality to aging hardware that would otherwise be sent to e-waste.
why_valuable: Demonstrates cost-effective maintenance of precision instruments while providing educational content for electronics enthusiasts interested in hardware repair and restoration.
